headline: Grumpy Walrus opened a new HOWDY position: ~19.35M HOWDY (~1.9% of supply) for ~919 ADA in three buys, 9:23-9:28 PM. HOWDY is a graduated Solada name at ~49.9k ADA mcap, 10.5k ADA side, 57 holders, 23.4k ADA 24h vol; fails rule k (holders under 120). The payload's NIGHT (~4,530 ADA), USDCX and ASCEND lines are dust or a stale repeat of the 7:59 PM NIGHT sale, not new trades. BET and VAMP top holder is the same cluster (, ~39% and ~37%). Both books empty.
